top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: FTC to probe major companies over personalized pricing and pay
top_signals.summary: The Federal Trade Commission ordered nine food delivery, airline and ride-sharing companies to turn over detailed information on how they harness personal data to set individual consumer prices and employee compensation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Chinese Investors Seek Shelter in Long-Bond ETFs as Stocks Sink
top_signals.summary: Chinese investors are piling into exchange-traded funds tracking longer-dated government bonds, seeking shelter in a rallying debt market while local stocks keep sliding.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Alphabet tanks nearly 13% for worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value
top_signals.summary: Alphabet reported a larger negative free cash flow than analysts had expected while maintaining its spending gudiance for the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Reddit shares sink on weak sales guidance and plans login requirement test as Google search traffic shrinks
top_signals.summary: Reddit posts third-quarter earnings and reveals plans to require all users to create official accounts as Google search traffic shrinks

top_signals.title: Binance hack drained billions through private key ‘misuse’: Blockaid CEO
top_signals.summary: Blockaid’s Ido Ben-Natan suspects attackers manipulated Binance’s transaction-signing infrastructure, drawing parallels with the Bybit hack.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
top_signals.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.
